checklist.why: Purpose stated; no "use X instead" line (for example a Status dot, or the word alone).
A single open-stroke path on a 24 grid; nothing optional.
Stroke weights (1.6 / 1.8-2 / key 2.2) listed with their sizes.
icon() emits aria-hidden="true" (not documented in the card).
The global svg rule uses raw 20px and stroke 1.8 (contradicting the 1.6 rule); screens set sizes in px.
All glyphs render at 375 without overflow.

variants.name: standard stroke (1.6)
findings: The bundle default svg stroke is 1.8, not 1.6.

variants.name: key stroke (2.2; backspace 1.8)
findings: Clean in use; held back only by the component-level token fail (line 11).

findings.text: Duplicate glyphs: origin = place (identical path), chevron = arrow (same path), plus ~ condition.
findings.fix: Keep one name per glyph (place, chevron, plus) and alias the others.

findings.text: Unknown names silently draw a chevron, which reads as "more" - a typo becomes a false affordance.
findings.fix: Return an empty svg and console.warn in development.

findings.text: A known bug is shipped: the grid path closes to x=3 (M14 3h7v7H3z).
findings.fix: Fix the squares to M14 3h7v7h-7z and M14 14h7v7h-7z.

findings.text: "more" is three 0.01px dots, near invisible at stroke 1.6 in glare.
findings.fix: Draw three r=1.5 filled dots, or stroke 2.4.

findings.text: The README says 52 glyphs; the preview renders 54 (backspace, offline).
findings.fix: Update the count or derive it from the registry.

findings.text: The global svg default (stroke 1.8, 20px) contradicts the 1.6 rule.
findings.fix: Set stroke-width from an icon-stroke token (1.6).

resolution.note: Findings addressed in the component pass; original judge scores preserved.
changes: Canonical non-enumerable aliases; condition shares plus.
Unknown names warn and return empty SVG; grid corrected; More uses three filled r=1.5 dots.
Registry count derived; default stroke token added; prototype registries removed.
